summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by H World Group Ltd announcing the record date for its annual general meeting of shareholders. It details the eligibility requirements for holders of ordinary shares and American Depositary Shares to attend and vote. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The filing simply provides administrative meeting logistics for May 2026.
